transcription_verified.method: Text extracted with PyMuPDF from the born-digital text layer, then read back against pages rendered at 150 dpi. Pages read back this session: 1 of 3. transcription_verified.residual_risk: Pages not read back rely on the text layer alone. A solving session must re-read its own paper in full before an answer is authored against it.
